practicalNextChecks: Run the Apple widget extension under Xcode on a simulator for gallery, family, placeholder/snapshot/timeline and tap-routing evidence.
On Mac, use Apple's WidgetKit Simulator for configurations, then check an installed signed app for actual desktop/Notification Center and shared storage behavior.
Verify App Group registration/profile inclusion for both host and extension, and extension embedding, with a signed installation.
Connect a physical Android device and test the real launcher picker, resize limits, multiple instances, cold/warm launches and saved-prayer lifecycle.
Test VoiceOver/TalkBack, Hebrew/Arabic ordering, large text, light/dark appearance, local midnight and time-zone changes.
Run the existing Windows CI job after an authorized push, or the native suite on an available Windows host; no CI claim is made for local-only commits.

primaryDocumentation.observed: Run widget-extension target to display a widget on target; _XCWidgetKind and _XCWidgetFamily select configuration/family. On Mac WidgetKit Simulator supports timeline, snapshot and placeholder inspection.
App Group capability and membership permit host/extension data sharing. Required registration and signatures must be verified separately from source entitlements.
Launcher cells and margins vary; targetCell dimensions express grid intent. Widget size lists are the launcher's responsibility and can be absent. Test supported resize ranges.
Manual accessibility-service interaction, tools, automated tests and user testing complement one another; static checks do not establish runtime accessibility.
